713:           "text": "Yes — **Meeting SDK itself is free to download and code with, no per-minute fee.**\n\nBut hosted meetings follow your **Zoom host account plan**, not the SDK:\n\n**1. SDK = free**\n> No charge to install `@zoom/meetingsdk`, get SDK Key/Secret, use Server-to-Server OAuth, join meetings in browser.\n\n**2. Meetings = needs a Zoom plan**\n> What the HR interviewer (host) owns decides limits:\n\n* **Free Basic - ₱0:** you can already embed real meetings in your popup. Unlimited 1-on-1, group meetings **up to 40 mins** (3-100 people). For most interviews this is actually enough.\n* **Pro (~$13-15 / mo / host):** removes 40-min limit, + cloud recording, + auto-transcripts.\n* **No extra fee** per applicant or per join — only the 1 host account needs Pro.\n\nThat's different from **Video SDK** (your own custom video UI) — that one *is* pay-per-minute.\n\n### For your case: `Start Zoom Interview` popup\n\nWhat you have now:\n\n```\n[local camera preview (getUserMedia)] + [Open in Zoom links]\n-> clicks out to zoom.us app / browser tab\n```\n\nWith Meeting SDK Component View:\n\n```\n[same popup, same eval form]\n+ real Zoom meeting embedded inside the Video Preview pane\n-> no Zoom software, stays in HRMS, HR + applicant see/hear each other there\n```\n\nRequirements to do that:\n1. Free Zoom Developer account -> Meeting SDK app (get SDK Key/Secret) + Server-to-Server OAuth (to create real meetings via API to replace your `ZoomMeetingService` mock)\n2. `https` (localhost ok for dev)\n3. I replace your mock `zoom.us/j/...` links with real `meetingNumber + token` and mount `client.join()` inside your `zoomVideoRef` box.\n\nWant me to wire it so:\n\n* If real Zoom creds exist -> shows **embedded Zoom** in the popup?\n* If not -> falls back to your current **local preview + Open in Zoom** (zero cost)?\n\nThat way you can use it free now (40-min limit) and upgrade to Pro later only if interviews run long / you need cloud recording.\n"

To build an AI notetaker application or access realtime media, use Zoom RTMS (Real-time media streams) . The Zoom Meeting SDK for web lets you embed the Zoom Meeting and Zoom Webinar experiences on a webpage through a highly optimized WebAssembly module. The SDK supports Angular, React, Vue.js, and other JS frameworks. The SDK strives for feature parity with the Zoom web client, however, some features may not be available. See features supported by web browser for details. Embed the Meeting SDK Embed Zoom on your website using a client view that displays the SDK using the full web page or a component view that splits the client into multiple components that you can position on the page. Or embed the Meeting SDK for web in an iFrame on a webpage and in WebViews on native Android and iOS apps. Client view Client view provides the option to display the Meeting SDK for web as a full page. This allows for a familiar Zoom experience as the client view is similar to the Zoom web client , except it lives inside your own web page. Component view The component view provides the option to display the Meeting SDK for web in components on your page. This allows for a more flexible design. Component view is designed specifically for desktop browser use cases, not mobile environments. For mobile use cases, use client view . Supported features Component view supports core meeting functionality and may not include some features supported in client view. Create a Server-to-Server OAuth app** (lets the backend make real meetings)\n- Same marketplace → Build App → **Server-to-Server OAuth** → Create\n- Add scopes: `meeting:write`, `meeting:read`, `user:read`\n- Get **Account ID** + **Client ID** + **Client Secret**\n\n**3. Fill your backend `.env`** (in `backend-laravel/.env`):\n```env\nZOOM_PROVIDER=api\nZOOM_SDK_KEY=paste_sdk_key\nZOOM_SDK_SECRET=paste_sdk_secret\nZOOM_ACCOUNT_ID=paste_account_id\nZOOM_CLIENT_ID=paste_client_id\nZOOM_CLIENT_SECRET=paste_client_secret\n```\nThen: `php artisan config:clear`\n\n**4. Book a Virtual interview** — from now on it creates a **real** Zoom meeting (real `zoom.us/j/<id>` link emailed to the applicant).\n\n> Old mock interviews still have fake IDs — embedded join will fail on those. Just book a fresh Virtual interview (or reschedule an old one so links regenerate) after step 3.\n\n**5. Click \"Start Zoom Interview\"**\n- With keys → popup header flips to **\"Zoom meeting — live in system\"** with the applicant + you on video **inside the HRMS** (browser will ask camera/mic permission once).\n- Without keys → same popup as before (local preview + Open in Zoom buttons). Nothing breaks.\n\n**Quick test checklist:**\n- [ ] `php artisan route:list --name=interview` shows `zoom-signature` ✅ (just confirmed above)\n- [ ] Serve over `http://localhost:5173` (or https in prod — Zoom requires valid origin)\n- [ ] Applicant opens their emailed link in the real Zoom app while you stay embedded — you'll see each other.\n\nCost reminder from earlier: SDK is free; meetings follow your host account (Free pl... 3555:           "text": "That exact text only appears in the 2nd `catch` — signature OK, but `init()`/`join()` threw. Top causes, in order:\n\n**1. Fake/mock meeting ID (most likely for you)**\nYour screenshot's interview was probably booked while `ZOOM_PROVIDER=mock` — those `zoom.us/j/...` links don't exist on Zoom, so the SDK rejects the join even with valid keys. Fix: book a **fresh Virtual interview now** (provider is `api` + keys present, so it'll be a real `us05web.zoom.us/j/<id>`), then Start Zoom on that one.\n\n**2. SDK Key ↔ Meeting mismatch**\nThe signature's `sdkKey` must belong to the same Zoom account that owns the meeting. If `ZOOM_SDK_KEY` came from a different marketplace app/account than the S2S OAuth app that created the meeting → join fails. Fix: both apps under the **same** marketplace account.\n\n**3. Meeting SDK app not activated / origin not allowed**\n- Marketplace → your Meeting SDK app → **Activate**.\n- Add `http://localhost:5173` (and your prod URL) to the SDK app's allow list.\n- Production needs **https** — Zoom blocks `http` origins except localhost.\n\n**4. Browser blocked it**\nNeeds camera/mic permission + a Chromium browser (Chrome/Edge). Ad-blockers/strict privacy sometimes kill the SDK WASM.\n\n**I just pushed a fix** so the box will now show the real cause, e.g.:\n> `Embedded Zoom could not start in this browser (Invalid meeting number / signature expired / ...) — use the Join link below.`\n\n**To confirm:** refresh, reopen Start Zoom Interview, and tell me the new text in parentheses + press F12 → Console → copy the `Zoom embedded join failed:` line. That tells us exactly which of the 4 it is. Also tell me: was that Maricel interview booked **before** you added the Zoom keys?"

86:     protected static function createViaApi(

88:         string $applicantName,
89:         ?string $interviewerName = null,

92:         $accountId = (string) config('services.zoom.account_id');
93:         $clientId = (string) config('services.zoom.client_id');

98:

100:             $tokenRes = Http::withBasicAuth($clientId, $clientSecret)->asForm()->post(
101:                 'https://zoom.us/oauth/token',
102:                 ['grant_type' => 'account_credentials', 'account_id' => $accountId]
103:             );
104:             if (! $tokenRes->successful()) {
105:                 Log::warning('Zoom OAuth failed: '.$tokenRes->body());
106:                 return null;
107:             }
108:             $accessToken = (string) ($tokenRes->json('access_token') ?? '');
109:             if ($accessToken === '') {
110:                 return null;
111:             }
112: 
113:             $topic = trim("Interview — {$applicantName}".($position ? " ({$position})" : ''));
114:             $agenda = trim("{$interviewCode}".($interviewerName ? " · Interviewer: {$interviewerName}" : ''));
115:             $createRes = Http::withToken($accessToken)->post('https://api.zoom.us/v2/users/me/meetings', [
116:                 'topic'    => mb_substr($topic, 0, 200),
117:                 'type'     => 2,
118:                 'agenda'   => mb_substr($agenda, 0, 2000),
119:                 'settings' => [
120:                     'waiting_room'     => true,
121:                     'join_before_host' => false,
122:                     'approval_type'    => 2,
123:                     'auto_recording'   => 'none',
124:                 ],
125:             ]);
126:             if (! $createRes->successful()) {
127:                 Log::warning('Zoom create meeting failed: '.$createRes->body());
128:                 return null;
129:             }
130:             $meetingId = (string) ($createRes->json('id') ?? '');
131:             $joinUrl = (string) ($createRes->json('join_url') ?? '');
132:             $password = (string) ($createRes->json('password') ?? '');
133:             if ($meetingId === '' || $joinUrl === '') {
134:                 return null;
135:             }
136: 
137:             return [

139:                 'join_url'     => $joinUrl,
140:                 'continue_url' => $joinUrl.'#rejoin',
141:                 'password'     => $password,
142:             ];
143:         } catch (\Throwable $e) {

149:     /** Whether the SDK embed is configured (Meeting SDK key pair present). */
150:     public static function sdkConfigured(): bool
151:     {
152:         return (string) config('services.zoom.sdk_key') !== ''
153:             && (string) config('services.zoom.sdk_secret') !== '';
154:     }
155: 
156:     /**
157:      * Mint a Meeting SDK JWT signature for Component View join.
158:      * Returns null when SDK keys are missing. The secret never leaves the server.
159:      */
160:     public static function sdkSignature(string $meetingNumber, int $role = 0): ?string
161:     {
162:         $sdkKey = (string) config('services.zoom.sdk_key');
163:         $sdkSecret = (string) config('services.zoom.sdk_secret');
164:         if ($sdkKey === '' || $sdkSecret === '') {
165:             return null;
166:         }
167: 
168:         $digits = (string) preg_replace('/\D/', '', $meetingNumber);
169:         if ($digits === '') {
170:             return null;
171:         }
172: 
173:         $enc = static fn (string $json): string => rtrim(strtr(base64_encode($json), '+/', '-_'), '=');
174:         $header = $enc((string) json_encode(['alg' => 'HS256', 'typ' => 'JWT']));
175:         $payload = $enc((string) json_encode([
176:             'sdkKey'   => $sdkKey,
177:             'appKey'   => $sdkKey,
178:             'mn'       => $digits,
179:             'role'     => $role,
180:             'iat'      => time(),
181:             'exp'      => time() + 7200,
182:             'tokenExp' => time() + 7200,
183:         ]));
184:         $sig = hash_hmac('sha256', $header.'.'.$payload, $sdkSecret, true);
185: 
186:         return $header.'.'.$payload.'.'.rtrim(strtr(base64_encode($sig), '+/', '-_'), '=');
187:     }
188:

194:     {

197:         }
198:         if (! empty($interview->zoom_join_url)) {
199:             return false;
200:         }
201:         $applicantName = $interview->applicant?->name ?? 'Applicant';
202:         $zoom = static::createForInterview(

204:             $applicantName,
205:             $interview->interviewer_name,
206:             $position ?? $interview->applicant?->jobPost?->title,
207:         );
208:         $interview->zoom_meeting_id = $zoom['meeting_id'];
209:         $interview->zoom_join_url = $zoom['join_url'];
210:         $interview->zoom_continue_url = $zoom['continue_url'];
211:         $interview->zoom_password = $zoom['password'];
212: 
213:         return true;
214:     }

- `frontend/vite.zoom-embed.config.ts` (new): lib build (`iife`) of `src/zoom-embed/zoom-embed.ts` + SDK + its own React copy → `public/zoom-sdk/zoom-embed.bundle.js`. No TanStack plugins, `copyPublicDir: false`.
- `frontend/public/zoom-embed.html`: now loads `/zoom-sdk/zoom-embed.bundle.js` (plain script, same path dev + prod).
- `frontend/package.json`: new `build:zoom-embed`, chained into `build` / `build:dev`. `frontend/.gitignore`: ignores `public/zoom-sdk/` (3.8MB artifact).

**Verified:**
- `npm run build:zoom-embed` → 1 file, 3.8MB, exit 0, no CSS sidecar
- Dev: `/zoom-sdk/zoom-embed.bundle.js` 200, `/zoom-embed.html` 200 (updated, 1060B)
- Full `npm run build:dev` exit 0; `dist/client/zoom-embed.html` + `dist/client/zoom-sdk/zoom-embed.bundle.js` both present
- Backend untouched and still green (route + signature JWT from prior test)

**Root cause:** the SDK's bundled UMD reads bare `process` at evaluation time (before any of our code runs). My first `define` shim only replaced some occurrences — the minified sections kept `process.env.NODE_ENV`, so the IIFE still died on line 1.

**Fix in `frontend/vite.zoom-embed.config.ts`:** Rollup `output.banner` prepending `var process=…{env:{NODE_ENV:"production"}}` — banner code runs before every bundled module, so `process` exists by the time the SDK touches it. Verified at byte 0 of the rebuilt bundle.

**Cleared the other two flags:**
- `nextTick` → inside a Node-vs-browser branch; our shim stringifies as `[object Object]`, so it takes the browser (`postMessage`) path. Never called.
- `require("util")` → guarded by `NT && NT.require && …`, short-circuits in browser. Never called.

- `frontend/public/zoom-embed.html`: loads React 18 → ReactDOM 18 → SDK UMD as plain scripts, boots via `window.ReactWidgets.createClient()` with the same postMessage protocol. If a script is missing it reports exactly which globals exist.

21: 
22:     /** Re-apply allowed after this many days even if still active. */
23:     public const REAPPLY_DAYS = 180;
24: 
25:     public static function hashFile(UploadedFile $file): ?string
26:     {
27:         try {
28:             $realPath = $file->getRealPath();
29:             if (! $realPath || ! is_file($realPath)) {
30:                 return null;
31:             }
32: 
33:             return hash_file('sha256', $realPath) ?: null;

35:             return null;
36:         }
37:     }

## Assistant

_Thinking:_



Here's how your Zoom interview works, simply:

**1. Schedule** — You book a Virtual interview for an applicant (date, time, interviewer). The system creates a real Zoom meeting and emails the applicant the Join link + password.

**2. Wait for the slot** — If the slot is 30 minutes at 10:30, the meeting can start 10:30–11:00. Before that it says "Starts at…", after that "window has passed".

**3. Start** — Click **Start Zoom Interview**. A popup opens with your camera preview, the applicant joins from their emailed link, and you see each other inside your system — no Zoom app needed.

**4. Interview** — Score the applicant on the form beside the video. Live captions run below. When done, save — the score and result are recorded.

The pieces behind it: your Zoom account hosts the meeting, your server makes the meeting + a join signature, and the popup embeds the live video.

Fixed — the preview now fills the pane every time (screenshot above). Measured proof:

- **Before:** `suspension-view-tabpanel-ribbon-multiple`, 250×274px filmstrip; tiles 236×131px; 660px of black stage.
- **After:** `suspension-view-tabpanel-gallery-multiple`, 800×457px; tiles 396×221px side-by-side with active-speaker border; toolbar centered below.

**Root cause:** the SDK boots into its floating ribbon/suspension view by default — a narrow filmstrip — regardless of container size. My earlier `viewSizes` only sized that filmstrip. The fix is one init option in `frontend/public/zoom-embed.html`: `defaultViewType: "gallery"` (documented `VideoOptions`), so the gallery spreads across the 910×560 stage on every open.

**Verified live in your browser:** reopened the room, gallery tiles + toolbar fill the pane, header "live in system", no errors. Then left the room and restored interview 65 to 11:00 AM. Full build green, nothing committed.

51:     return value;
52:   } catch {

54:   }
55: }

57: /** Normalize portal role names ("Super Admin" -> "superadmin"). */
58: export function roleKeyFor(role: string | null | undefined): string {
59:   const k = String(role ?? "")
60:     .toLowerCase()
61:     .replace(/[_\-\s]/g, "");
62:   if (k === "superadmin") return "superadmin";
63:   if (k === "admin" || k === "administrator") return "admin";
64:   return "employee";
65: }
66: 
67: /** Effective {token, idle} minutes for the currently signed-in user. */
68: export function policyForCurrentUser(policy: SessionPolicy | null): RolePolicy {
69:   const roles = policy?.roles ?? FALLBACK_ROLES;
70:   const key = roleKeyFor(getUser()?.role);
71:   return (
72:     roles[key] ??
73:     FALLBACK_ROLES[key] ?? { token_minutes: 480, idle_minutes: 15 }
74:   );
75: }
76: 
77: /**
78:  * Enforces role-based absolute + idle session timeouts inside the portal.
79:  * - Super Admin: 4h token / 10m idle
80:  * - Admin:       8h token / 15m idle
81:  * - Employee:   12h token / 30m idle
82:  */
83: export function useSessionTimeout() {
84:   const navigate = useNavigate();
85:   const policyRef = useRef<SessionPolicy | null>(null);
86: 
87:   useEffect(() => {
88:     let cancelled = false;
89:     getSessionPolicy().then((p) => {
90:       if (!cancelled) policyRef.current = p;
91:     });
92:     return () => {
93:       cancelled = true;
94:     };
95:   }, []);
96: 
97:   useEffect(() => {
98:     const onActivity = () => touchActivity();
99:     const events: (keyof WindowEventMap)[] = [
100:       "mousedown",
101:       "keydown",
102:       "touchstart",
103:       "wheel",
104:     ];
105:     events.forEach((e) => window.addEventListener(e, onActivity, { passive: true }));
106:     touchActivity();
107: 
108:     const logout = async (reason: "expired" | "idle") => {
109:       try {
110:         await authApi.logout();
111:       } catch {
112:         /* token already invalid */
113:       }
114:       clearSession();
115:       const effective = policyForCurrentUser(policyRef.current);
116:       toast.warning(
117:         reason === "idle"
118:           ? `Signed out after ${effective.idle_minutes} minutes of inactivity.`
119:           : `Session expired after ${effective.token_minutes} minutes. Please sign in again.`,
120:       );
121:       navigate({ to: "/login" });
122:     };
123: 
124:     const tick = () => {
125:       if (!getToken()) return;
126:       const effective = policyForCurrentUser(policyRef.current);
127:       if (isSessionExpired(effective.token_minutes)) {
128:         void logout("expired");
129:         return;
130:       }
131:       const idle = getIdleMinutes();
132:       if (idle != null && idle >= effective.idle_minutes) {
133:         void logout("idle");
134:       }
135:     };
136: 
137:     const timer = window.setInterval(tick, 30_000);
138:     return () => {
139:       window.clearInterval(timer);
140:       events.forEach((e) => window.removeEventListener(e, onActivity));
141:     };
142:   }, [navigate]);
143: }

---

## Summary of UI Fixes

### 1. **No More Black Stage (Video fills the pane)**
- **embed page** (`public/zoom-embed.html`): Replaced hardcoded `800×450` viewSizes with the actual iframe window size. The SDK now renders exactly to the pane's 16:9 box.
- **Dialog sizing** (`ApplicantManagement.tsx`): The Zoom room dialog is now computed via CSS `--zoom-room-h` so the stage cell is always 16:9 (`aspect-video`), eliminating letterbox bands.

### 2. **Chromeless, Focused Layout**
- **Left pane**: Meeting only — no card, no gray header, no border.
- **Right pane (scorecard)**: Compact single-row criteria with **tap-to-rate 1–5 buttons** (no dropdowns) so scoring during a live call takes one click.
- **Header** moved to top bar: applicant identity + **Live** badge + **Invite** / **Notes** toggle buttons + **Leave** — all one row.
- **Invite drawer** (collapsed by default): Join/Continue links, password, copy/open buttons.
- **Notes drawer** (collapsed by default): Live transcription with manual caption line, copy/clear.

### 3. **Behavior Verified**
| Flow | Result |
|------|--------|
| **Virtual — Start Zoom Interview** | Opens the room; scoring stays inside; **Leave → no standalone form pops** |
| **On-site — Start Interview** | Opens the standalone Interview dialog (Select dropdowns for rating) — untouched path |
| **Slot-window gating** | Start button only appears inside the 30-min window (date + time) |
| **Camera-off pill** | Shows "No video yet — enable your camera in the toolbar" with dismiss; clears when any participant turns video on |

### Files Changed
| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `frontend/public/zoom-embed.html` | Dynamic `viewSizes` = iframe size; full-height init; dark bg |
| `frontend/src/components/applicants/ZoomEmbeddedMeeting.tsx` | `fill` prop; `h-full w-full`; pill at bottom-center |
| `frontend/src/components/modules/ApplicantManagement.tsx` | Rewritten Zoom room dialog (header + two panes + two collapsible drawers), 16:9 CSS sizing, compact scorecard with tap buttons |

No commits yet — all changes are in the working tree on `merging-ground`. Ready for your review.

479:   result: "MATCH" | "MISMATCH" | "UNABLE_TO_EXTRACT" | string;

481:    *  tolerance window still count as the same period). */

512: export function resolveStorageUrl(value: string | null): string | null {
513:   if (!value) return null;
514:   // BASE_URL may be relative ("/api/v1") so this works on any dev port.
515:   // Fall back to the page origin when it is not an absolute URL.
516:   let origin: string;
517:   try {
518:     origin = new URL(
519:       BASE_URL,
520:       typeof window !== "undefined" ? window.location.origin : "http://localhost",
521:     ).origin;
522:   } catch {
523:     origin = typeof window !== "undefined" ? window.location.origin : "http://127.0.0.1:8000";
524:   }
525:   try {
526:     const normalized = value.replace(/\\/g, "/").replace(/^\.\//, "");
527:     const u = new URL(normalized, origin);
528:     return `${origin}${u.pathname}${u.search}`;
529:   } catch {
530:     return value.replace(/\\/g, "/");
531:   }
532: }

534: export const applicantsApi = {
535:   list: (params?: Record<string, any>) => {
536:     const qs = new URLSearchParams(params).toString();
537:     return request<{ data: ApiApplicant[]; meta: any }>(`/applicants${qs ? `?${qs}` : ""}`);
538:   },
539:   get: (id: number | string) => request<ApiApplicant>(`/applicants/${id}`),
540:   create: (formData: FormData | Record<string, any>) => {
541:     const isForm = formData instanceof FormData;
542:     return request<ApiApplicant>("/applicants", {
543:       method: "POST",
544:       body: isForm ? formData : JSON.stringify(formData),
545:     });
546:   },
547:   update: (id: number | string, data: FormData | Record<string, any>) => {
548:     const isForm = data instanceof FormData;
549:     if (isForm) {
550:       // PHP never populates $_POST for raw multipart PUT bodies, so Laravel
551:       // sees an empty request. Send POST with a _method=PUT override field —
552:       // the standard Laravel pattern for multipart updates.
553:       data.append("_method", "PUT");
554:     }
555:     return request<ApiApplicant>(`/applicants/${id}`, {
556:       method: isForm ? "POST" : "PUT",
557:       body: isForm ? data : JSON.stringify(data),
558:     });
559:   },
560:   delete: (id: number | string) =>
561:     request<{ message: string }>(`/applicants/${id}`, { method: "DELETE" }),
562:   hire: (id: number | string) =>
563:     request<ApiApplicant>(`/applicants/${id}/hire`, { method: "POST" }),
564:   stats: () => request<any>("/applicants/stats"),
565:   extractResume: (formData: FormData) =>
566:     request<{
567:       success: boolean;
568:       processing_status?: string | null;
569:       personal_information?: {
570:         name?: string | null;
571:         email?: string | null;
572:         phone?: string | null;
573:         address?: string | null;
574:       };
575:       error_message?: string;
576:     }>("/applicants/extract-resume", {
577:       method: "POST",
578:       body: formData,
579:     }),
580:   screenResume: (formData: FormData) =>
581:     request<ApiScreeningPreview>("/applicants/screen-resume", {
582:       method: "POST",
583:       body: formData,
584:     }),
585:   getScreening: (id: number | string) =>
586:     request<{ data: ApiScreening }>(`/applicants/${id}/screening`),
587:   /** Re-runs the screening classification with the current supporting-document
588:    *  evidence (after uploading / re-verifying / removing a document) so the
589:    *  ranking percentage, rank order and official status stay in sync. */
590:   recomputeScreening: (id: number | string) =>
591:     request<{ data: ApiScreening; applicant: ApiApplicant }>(
592:       `/applicants/${id}/screening/recompute`,
593:       { method: "POST" },
594:     ),
595:   /** Streams the applicant's stored resume from the backend — always
596:    *  accessible, independent of the public/storage symlink, and same-origin
597:    *  (relative) so the review dialog's preview <iframe>/<img> renders PDFs
598:    *  and images inline instead of a blank white box. The Vite dev proxy
599:    *  forwards /api to Laravel. The auth token is appended as ?token= so the
600:    *  request authenticates server-side without an Authorization header. */
601:   resumeDocumentUrl: (applicantId: number | string) => {
602:     const token = getToken();
603:     return `/api/v1/applicants/${applicantId}/resume-document${
604:       token ? `?token=${encodeURIComponent(token)}` : ""
605:     }`;
606:   },
607:   createAssessment: (applicantId: number | string, data: Record<string, any>) =>
608:     request<ApiAssessment>(`/applicants/${applicantId}/assessments`, {
609:       method: "POST",
610:       body: JSON.stringify(data),
611:     }),
612: };

  /** True while the View screen was opened from the New Hire Onboarding

  const [viewedFromOnboarding, setViewedFromOnboarding] = useState(false);
  /** Queued "View Checklist" target handed over from New Hire Onboarding. */
  const [checklistViewTarget, setChecklistViewTarget] = useState<ChecklistViewTarget | null>(null);

  /* Consume the queued hand-off once. The target is carried in state, so a
     double-invoked effect run (React dev) can never drain the store twice and
     drop the request. */
  useEffect(() => {
    const target = hireStore.consumePendingChecklistView();
    if (target) setChecklistViewTarget(target);
  }, []);

  /**
   * Opens the handed-over applicant in the View profile right away �?" the
   * Requirements Checklist is forced as the landing section.

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!checklistViewTarget) return;
    const { applicantId, applicantName } = checklistViewTarget;

    /* Direct route �?" the hire knows its applicant id. Fetched directly so
       Hired records (excluded from the active pipeline list) still open. */
    if (applicantId != null) {
      setChecklistViewTarget(null);
      applicantsApi
        .get(applicantId)
        .then((res) => {
          setViewedFromOnboarding(true);
          setViewingApplicant(transformApiApplicant(res));
        })
        .catch((e) => {
          console.warn("Could not open the applicant View profile:", e);
          toast.error("Could not open the applicant's view profile.");
        });
      return;
    }

    /* Legacy records without applicant_id: wait for the pipeline list, then
       resolve the applicant by exact name �?" falling back to the full applicants
       list, which still includes Hired records. */
    if (rows.length === 0) return;
    setChecklistViewTarget(null);
    const wanted = applicantName.trim().toLowerCase();
    const local = rows.find((r) => r.name.trim().toLowerCase() === wanted);
    if (local) {
      setViewedFromOnboarding(true);
      setViewingApplicant(local);
      return;
    }
    fetchAllPages(applicantsApi.list)
      .then((items) => {
        const match = items
          .map(transformApiApplicant)
          .find((r) => r.name.trim().toLowerCase() === wanted);
        if (!match) {
          toast.error(
            `No applicant profile matches "${applicantName}" �?" this hire was filed without an applicant.`,
          );
          return;
        }
        setViewedFromOnboarding(true);
        setViewingApplicant(match);
      })
      .catch((e) => {
        console.warn("Could not resolve the applicant for this hire:", e);
        toast.error("Could not open the applicant's view profile.");
      });
  }, [checklistViewTarget, rows]);

  /** Closing the View screen clears the onboarding-origin flag. */
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!viewingApplicant) setViewedFromOnboarding(false);
  }, [viewingApplicant]);
